args.body: Take PAID-EDITORIAL-COMMISSION-TEST after checking equivalent evidence and obtaining its actual lease. This is a bounded alternative to the commercially undifferentiated tender offer. Verify commissioning, remuneration, AI permission and submission prerequisites before drafting; reject unsupported candidates early. Existing technical artifacts may support an original demonstration only where their reuse rights and claims are established. Stop after three candidates or one qualified proposal/demonstration. No outreach, agreements, accounts, spending or deployment. Preserve tender observation windows and expiry duties. Report advertised pay separately from eligibility, submission, acceptance and settled revenue.

description: The latest comparison found that our free tender preview duplicates the proposed CAD49 deliverable, so further tender development lacks a supported paid distinction. Feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified, and no revenue or spendable funds are verified. Preserve live experiments and expiry duties while testing a separate paid editorial channel; existing marketplace and payment dependencies do not establish a global blockage.
